subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate idiom from the given options to fill in the blank.

Greta Thunberg _____________ when she dared to question about accountability with respect to global warming and climate change.

options.text: hit the nail on the head

solution:
The correct answer is: **hit the nail on the head.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"hit the nail on the head"** means to describe exactly what is causing a situation or problem. (सही निशाना लगाना)

 
 
• **Example: **When he said that the company's downfall was due to poor management, he really hit the nail on the head.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Sowed wild oats** (अराजक जीवन जीना): To engage in reckless or promiscuous behavior, especially in one's youth.

 
 
• **Example:** In his younger days, he sowed his wild oats before settling down.
 
 
 
• **Kept the pot boiling** (स्थिति को गर्म बनाए रखना): To keep a situation active or interesting.
 
 
• **Example:** She kept the pot boiling with her controversial comments.
 
 
 
• **Gave the devil his due** (दुश्मन की प्रशंसा करना): To acknowledge the good qualities of a person who is otherwise disliked.
 
 
• **Example:** Though I don't like him, I have to give the devil his due for his hard work.
